chapter_keywords: a record of a mortal’s journey to immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 337 – Han Li's Audit of Sun Ergou: A Deadly Poison Revealed
chapter_meta_description: Han Li locates his assassination target and checks in on the gang boss he installed years ago—only to find that Sun Ergou has been fatally poisoned and has just one month to live.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality – Chief Sun
og_description: A quiet chapter where Han Li performs a strategic audit of his mortal-world assets and uncovers a ticking time bomb.
twitter_title: RMJI 337 – Han Li finds out his puppet has been fatally poisoned.
twitter_description: Han Li’s routine check-in on Sun Ergou turns into a new survival puzzle: someone has planted a slow-acting poison in his old asset.

lore_anchors.definition: A Jianghu organization in Jiayuan City; its leader is Han Li’s assassination target for a contracted job.
A mid-ranking gang in Jiayuan City, elevated from poverty under the leadership of Sun Ergou, Han Li’s installed asset.
The former dockworker and now wealthy gang boss of the Siping Gang, placed and left to develop autonomously by Han Li over a decade ago.
A slow-acting toxin that does not immediately kill; by the time the victim or a cultivator detects it, the damage is often already at a critical stage.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li visit Sun Ergou after all these years?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is performing a strategic asset audit: checking whether the mortal power network he planted is still viable and whether it has drawn any dangerous attention.
The chapter does not reveal the poisoner’s identity or motive. It is left as a mystery for Han Li (and the reader) to investigate.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li’s voice turn ice-cold when delivering the poison news?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is not emotionally moved by Sun’s plight; he is immediately recalculating the tactical situation. A compromised asset is a liability, and the discovery forces him to reassess his entire mission plan.
